in_sanskrit.name: Sukhpal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Happiness or Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sukhpal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sukh means happiness and pal means prosperity or wealth, hence the name Sukhpal means a person who is happy and prosperous.

in_hindi.name: Sukhpal
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Happiness or Prosperity
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sukhpal एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sukh means happiness and pal means prosperity or wealth, hence the name Sukhpal means a person who is happy and prosperous.

in_tamil.name: Sukhpal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Happiness or Prosperity
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sukhpal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Sukh means happiness and pal means prosperity or wealth, hence the name Sukhpal means a person who is happy and prosperous.

in_telugu.name: Sukhpal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Happiness or Prosperity
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sukhpal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Sukh means happiness and pal means prosperity or wealth, hence the name Sukhpal means a person who is happy and prosperous.

in_marathi.name: Sukhpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Happiness or Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sukhpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sukh means happiness and pal means prosperity or wealth, hence the name Sukhpal means a person who is happy and prosperous.

in_bengali.name: Sukhpal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Happiness or Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sukhpal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sukh means happiness and pal means prosperity or wealth, hence the name Sukhpal means a person who is happy and prosperous.
